EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, trading on NASDAQ under the ticker EH, with CIK 0001759783. On its own website the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it serves customers across several industries with AAV products and commercial solutions.

The site lists the areas it addresses as urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media. Its product and solution headings are passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions. EHang describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry.

The material available does not include any litigation or enforcement matters involving the company. No specific products, aircraft models, or partnerships are named in the text reviewed here.
